say: Token holders vote on Snapshot. A Safe multisig executes the result. Nothing checks that they match. AsVoted does, on GenLayer.
Every action is decoded from the calldata. Two calls here are quoted in the proposal. Two go to a contract it never names, so the verdict is: deviates.
Velora returned exactly 40.203 wrapped ether to Bybit, as voted. Code settled it, no model needed.

Code decides first. A model only reads the words, and must quote them. DAOs pledge a bond, anyone can file a check, and there is no admin. Fifteen real executions, all on chain at asvoted dot vercel dot app.
